2B.22 The power to do great things is given to those that have faith and doubt not.

precepts.text: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
precepts.point: Jesus himself drew near and went with them, but their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

note.label: Luke 24: The Resurrection and the Opening of the Scriptures

precepts.why:
Two of them walked to Emmaus talking of all that had happened, and “Jesus himself drew near, and went with them. But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.”

Mark tells the same walk in a few words: “After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.” He appeared in another form. That is why their eyes were holden: the risen Christ walking beside them did not look as they had known him, so two men who had followed him did not know who was with them.

precepts.text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved, and these signs follow them that believe: casting out devils, new tongues, taking up serpents, drinking no deadly thing to their hurt, and healing the sick.
precepts.point: Christians misunderstand this power as merely speaking in tongues, but the Bible defines the power of the Holy Ghost by the signs that follow: casting out devils, speaking with new tongues, taking up serpents, drinking any deadly thing unharmed, and laying hands on the sick to recover. Peter was sought to heal by his shadow and Paul by his handkerchief.

note.label: Acts 1: The Promise of the Father and the Kingdom Restored to Israel

precepts.why:
“But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you.” Christians misunderstand this power as merely speaking in tongues, but the Bible defines the power of the Holy Ghost by the signs that follow.

“He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned. And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues; They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.”

That is the power the apostles received. Peter was sought to heal by his shadow, and Paul by his handkerchief.

precepts.text: Go into all the world and preach the gospel, and these signs shall follow: they shall speak with new tongues, because they were going into all the world.
precepts.point: They were filled with the wisdom of the Most High to interpret and speak in the different languages of the lands where Israel had been deported, not glossolalia. If Christ commanded them to go teach all nations, they had to be given the power to speak in the tongues of those nations, and these illiterate Galileans spoke perfectly in languages they never learned.

note.label: Acts 2: Pentecost and the Scattered House of Israel

precepts.why:
“Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.” If Christ commanded them to go and teach all nations, they had to be given the power to speak in the tongues of those nations.

So among the signs that follow them that believe: “they shall speak with new tongues”. New tongues, because they were going into all the world. That is what filled with the Holy Ghost means here: illiterate Galileans given the wisdom to speak the languages of the lands where Israel had been deported, so the gospel could be preached there.

precepts.text: These signs shall follow them that believe: casting out devils, speaking with new tongues, and laying hands on the sick that they recover.
precepts.point: In the last days the pattern is to call the elders of the church to pray over the sick and anoint with oil, for prophecies, tongues, and such knowledge would cease once the name of Christ was established.

note.label: Acts 5: All Things Common, and We Ought to Obey God Rather Than Men

precepts.why:
Christ had said, “And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues; They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.”

This is that fulfilled. They waited in Jerusalem for the Holy Ghost, the power was poured out, and now the sick are healed every one and the unclean spirits cast out, so that even the shadow of Peter passing by was sought.
